title: Use a nearby square you know
text: $$10^{2} = 100$$ and $$11^{2} = 121$$, so the root is a little larger than 11. A common mistake is to divide by 2 and answer 72. What is $$12 \times 12$$?

title: Name the root
text: You just showed that 12 squared is 144. The radical asks for the nonnegative number you squared. What is that number?

title: Worked solution
text: $$\sqrt{144} = 12$$, because $$12^{2} = 144$$. Common mistake: dividing 144 by 2. General rule: search for the whole number whose square is the radicand, and confirm by multiplying that number by itself.
